verdict.rationale: Linear publishes an llms.txt at linear.app/llms.txt, which states that every page on linear.app is also available as Markdown. Its developer docs (GraphQL, SDK, webhooks, agents, rate limiting, deprecations) are served as .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed straight at them. missing for 10: detail on how the llms.txt index is structured or what it covers, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents consume it well.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Each page on linear.app is also available as Markdown.
Linear's public API is built using GraphQL. It's the same API we use internally for developing our applications.
Agents behave similar to other users in a workspace.
